queue.title: What Is the Quantum Go-to-Market Playbook?
queue.description:
A quick introduction to the Quantum Go-to-Market Playbook: a guide for aligning your vision around the five parts of the Quantum Growth Model (target, attract, nurture, convert and wow) and then bringing sales, marketing and operations together with the right integration and automation.

Learn more: https://www.thequantumleap.business/services/go-to-market-program?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=quantum-growth-model

Book time with Shawn: https://meetings.hubspot.com/shawn-peterson

Shawn Peterson is CEO of Quantum Business Solutions, a HubSpot Platinum Solutions Partner that helps B2B sales teams systemize, optimize and automate revenue growth. https://www.thequantumleap.business

queue.title: The Quantum Growth Model, Part 1: Target and Attract Your Dream Clients
queue.description:
The Quantum Growth Model is a flywheel: systemize, optimize and automate five stages and it spins faster as productivity grows. Shawn Peterson covers the first two. Target means defining your ideal client profile and the buyer personas inside it. Attract means reaching those people with the paid, email, social and direct outreach that speaks to their exact problems.

Learn more: https://www.thequantumleap.business/services/go-to-market-program?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=quantum-growth-model

Book time with Shawn: https://meetings.hubspot.com/shawn-peterson

Shawn Peterson is CEO of Quantum Business Solutions, a HubSpot Platinum Solutions Partner that helps B2B sales teams systemize, optimize and automate revenue growth. https://www.thequantumleap.business
queue.title_hint: Daily Goal Setting: Break Big Goals Into Daily Steps

queue.title: The Quantum Growth Model, Part 2: Nurture, Convert and Wow Your Clients
queue.description:
The rest of the Quantum Growth Model. Nurture every prospect down their own buyer's journey with a 365 day follow-up plan, convert with a sales process built for it, then wow new clients so you keep, grow and multiply them. Shawn also maps the buyer's side of the table (awareness, consideration, decision, conversion, execution) and the four steps to put it in place: systemize, optimize, automate and execute.

Learn more: https://www.thequantumleap.business/services/go-to-market-program?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=quantum-growth-model

queue.title: Consultative Selling: Don't Rush the Needs Analysis
queue.description:
Seeing yourself as a consultative seller changes how the whole sale feels. Shawn Peterson explains why great questions and a real relationship take the friction out of selling, and why the needs analysis is where you learn the prospect's current situation, where they want to go, and how you bridge the gap.

Learn more: https://www.thequantumleap.business/b2bsales?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=b2b-sales-process

queue.title: Train Like a Pro Athlete: Why Sales Teams Need Daily Role Play
queue.description:
The best athletes train every day, yet most sales teams train once a year. Shawn Peterson makes the case for a role play every morning: nail the greeting, earn a minute to explain why you're calling, pitch, handle the common objections, close, and build the relationship that keeps and grows the customer.

Learn more: https://www.thequantumleap.business/b2bsales?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=b2b-sales-process

queue.title_hint: Sales Training vs. Sales Development: Fix the Front of the Funnel
queue.summary_hint: One sales training is an event; getting better is a lifestyle. Shawn Peterson explains how to review your own calls like game film and why a 20% gain at the front of your process lifts every step after it.
hint_chapters: Train like an athlete
Training is an event, development is a lifestyle
Fix the front and everything downstream improves

queue.title: Go-to-Market Assessment: Market Analysis, Benchmarks, Goals and Buyer Personas
queue.description:
Step one of a go-to-market strategy is an honest assessment. Shawn Peterson walks through sizing the market and the competition, a SWOT on your own company, the benchmark KPIs to baseline (email, meetings, pipeline, deal size, retention, NPS), setting SMART business goals, and defining your ideal client profile and the buyer personas inside it.

Learn more: https://www.thequantumleap.business/services/go-to-market-program?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=quantum-growth-model

Book time with Shawn: https://meetings.hubspot.com/shawn-peterson

queue.title_hint: In-Person Cold Calling: How to Get Past the Gatekeeper
queue.summary_hint: How to walk into a prospect's office and leave with the decision maker's name, or a handoff to them. Shawn Peterson covers the confidence to walk in, the one line that lowers a gatekeeper's guard, getting side by side instead of across a desk, and why the more they share, the more they trust you.

Match their body language
"I'm hoping you can help me"
If the decision maker isn't available
Get side by side, not across a desk

queue.description:
The rest of the go-to-market assessment. Build a value matrix that ties each persona's pain points to your value and message, plan for the six to ten stakeholders in a typical B2B purchase, audit your sales and marketing tech stack for automation opportunities, and baseline what you spend against what it returns using the Quantum Revenue Efficiency Model.

queue.title_hint: Talking to the Decision Maker: How to Layer Your Questions
queue.summary_hint: You made it past the gatekeeper. Now what? Shawn Peterson shows how to lower the decision maker's guard, find out who else is involved in the decision, and use layered questions to uncover what really matters before you share anything about your offer.

queue.description:
Bring your segmented database, ideal client profile and buyer personas together into one target audience. Shawn Peterson covers why calling the wrong half of a list cuts your pipeline in half, messaging built on your value proposition, differentiators and outcomes, lead scoring that triggers the right follow-up, and the conversion KPIs to optimize against.
